structure: Part 4, Reason for import, read at commit 04a073b in full: the DR2.1 override view app/views/design-release-2.1/reason-for-import.html (78 lines); the four root partials routes.js renders into the radio conditionals (partials/internal-market-purpose-select.html, transhipment-destination-country-select.html, transit-options-select.html, temporary-admission-horses-select.html); the data lists app/data/import-reasons.js (5 reasons), internal-market-purposes.js (11 purposes), exit-border-control-posts.js (10 posts) and certification-purposes.js (16 options); and app/routes.js lines 1616-1756 (germinal filtering of reasons and purposes, completeness rule hasImportReasonComplete, validateImportReasonProceed, a no-op redirectIfNoImportReason), 10371-10411 (purpose radio items, destination country select items), 10525-10585 (exit border control post select items, buildImportReasonItems wiring each conditional), 10757-10870 (renderReasonForImportPage, which renders the four partials then the page; the rest of the range is document type constants for the documents part, not claimed here), 11523-11538 (GET /prototype/reason-for-import seeding and GET /reason-for-import) and 12286-12389 (POST /reason-for-import). To read the handlers correctly it also read, without claiming their own pages, the helpers they call: seedPrototypeSessionForReasonForImport, redirectIfNoOrigin, isFromHub/isFromReview/isFromTemplateReview, getJourneyBackLink, getJourneyFormAction, isJourneySoftSaveAction, getJourneySaveRedirect, getSectionContinueRedirect, isValidExitBorderControlPost, parseArrivalDisplayDate, hasGerminalProductsOnly, app/data/countries.js and the DR2.1 journey-form-actions partial, plus version-mount.js's JOURNEY_PATH_PREFIXES (which lists /reason-for-import and /prototype/reason-for-import). One page is covered: Main import reason, with its five reasons, the four conditional reveals (internal market purpose radios; transhipment destination country select; transit port of exit and destination country selects; temporary admission horses exit date picker and port of exit select), the germinal-products filtering, soft validation and its six error messages, the save, hub and review actions, where the page leads, and the completeness rule the hub uses. The certification-purposes list is not used by this page (it feeds the additional animal details page); it is claimed as data with that note.
